checks.text: The page displays the heading "PDF Splitter".
Dropping a file named "report.pdf" into the drop zone labeled "Drop PDF here" displays a preview card with the text "report.pdf" and "3 pages".
Selecting the "Split" tab, entering "1-2" in the field labeled "Page range", and clicking the button "Process" displays a success message "Split complete" and enables the button "Download PDF".
Clicking the button "Download PDF" after a successful split triggers a file download named "report_split.pdf".
Selecting the "Merge" tab, dropping a second file "notes.pdf", and clicking the button "Process" displays a success message "Merge complete" and enables the button "Download PDF".
Clicking the button "Download PDF" after a successful merge triggers a file download named "merged.pdf".
After processing a file, the "History" tab displays a list item containing the text "report.pdf" and "Split".
Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all items from the "History" tab list.
Reload keeps the history entry "report.pdf" and "Split" visible in the "History" tab.
